text.trait_ruler_corvette_focus_desc: This leader is intent on promoting the construction of Corvettes.
text.trait_ruler_destroyer_focus_desc: This leader is intent on promoting the construction of Destroyers.
text.trait_ruler_cruiser_focus_desc: This leader is intent on promoting the construction of Cruisers.
text.trait_ruler_battleship_focus_desc: This leader is intent on promoting the construction of Battleships.
text.leader_trait_fleet_logistician_desc: This leader has mastered the field of logistics, and knows how to manage supplies to keep upkeep costs down.
text.leader_trait_skirmisher_desc: This leader prefers to skirmish against their opponents before engaging them in fair combat.
text.leader_trait_aggressive_desc: This leader is notoriously aggressive, overwhelming the enemy with numerous barrages from their fleet's weapons.
text.leader_trait_cautious_desc: This leader is a cautious commander, avoiding unnecessary risks and taking care to always maintain formations in which fleet units can mutually support each other against the enemy.
text.leader_trait_unyielding_desc: This leader would prefer to fight to the death than admit defeat.
text.leader_trait_engineer_desc: This leader is a natural engineer, having the knowledge and skills to organize and oversee starship repairs while on missions.
text.leader_trait_trickster_desc: This leader fights deviously, relying on misdirection and surprise to get the better of the enemy.
text.leader_trait_wrecker_desc: This leader is not concerned with leaving enemy ships in a salvageable state for research, preferring to vaporize them if possible.
text.leader_trait_annihilator_desc: This leader focuses on the quick destruction of planetary defenses.
text.leader_trait_artillerist_desc: This leader favors heavy ordinance and alpha strike techniques.
text.leader_trait_commanding_presence_desc: This leader holds a special place in the navy, attracting the most skilled captains and logisticians.
text.leader_trait_corsair_desc: This leader is dedicated to collecting any useful items from defeated enemy ships.
text.leader_trait_demolisher_desc: This leader is exceptionally skilled at demolishing stationary defenses.
text.leader_trait_shipbreaker_desc: This leader dismantles defeated enemy ships after every battle, recycling the alloys.
text.leader_trait_archaeo_specialization_desc: This leader favors ancient technology, convinced that they will bring unexpected advantages to the battlefield.
text.leader_trait_artillery_specialization_de: This leader favors long-range engagement with artillery playing the main role in their fleet.
text.only_one_admiral_focus: §YOnly one Admiral focus can be selected.§!
text.leader_trait_carrier_specialization_desc: This leader favors small strike crafts and screening ships to protect their valuable carriers.
text.leader_trait_rocketry_specialization_des: This leader favors missile strikes above all else, aiming at delivering a devastating blow to enemy fleets.
text.leader_trait_gunship_specialization_desc: This leader favors point-blank engagements, hoping to neutralize the enemy's long-range weapons.
text.leader_trait_juryrigger_desc: This leader knows how to use debris to patch up a fleet before another engagement.

text.leader_trait_surgical_bombardment_desc: This leader can identify valuable military targets with ease.
text.leader_trait_scout_desc: This leader is an expert at reconnaissance, having the technical skill to slip past even the most dangerous entities.
text.leader_trait_gale_speed_desc: This leader believes that speed and rapid maneuvers are the keys to success in any space engagement.
text.trait_ruler_fortifier_desc: This ruler understands the value in using military stations to secure territory.
text.leader_trait_armada_logistician_desc: Proper logistics are at the heart of any armada. This leader knows this and maintains a strict regime to control all expenses and procure timely deliveries.
text.trait_ruler_military_pioneer_desc: This leader is enthusiastic about advancements in military technology and ship construction.
text.leader_trait_intimidator_desc: This leader possesses a grim presence, easily intimidating fearful enemies.
text.leader_trait_border_guard_desc: This leader believes that the best way to win the war is to maintain impenetrable border defenses.
text.leader_trait_crew_trainer_desc: This leader instructs lower-ranking navy officers in advanced combat doctrines before they are released into active duty.
text.leader_trait_master_gunner_desc: An admiral with a heavy focus on weapons development, they always keep both their person and their guns in pristine working order.
text.leader_trait_military_overseer_desc: Naval organization is a difficult task, requiring careful planning and impeccable standards. This leader's experience is an invaluable asset in building an efficient navy.
text.leader_trait_armorer_desc: This leader has devised new ways to harden armor. There are few weapons in the galaxy that can penetrate the hulls of ships constructed with [Root.GetHisHer] designs.
text.leader_trait_destiny_engineer_desc: In space warfare, any mistake can turn deadly. This leader insists on strict maintenance routines to keep the fleet in excellent condition.
text.leader_trait_guerilla_tactics_desc: Large fleets are not always the best tool for the job. This admiral is adept at commanding small units to outmaneuver slower or more numerous opponents.
text.leader_trait_survivalist_desc: The embodiment of a protector, this admiral is a true mainstay on the front lines, obstructing any foes who dare to enter our territory.
text.leader_trait_maven_of_war_desc: Holding this title is a great honor. Such an admiral not only possesses vast knowledge of war, but is also a crucial link to colleagues in the science department.
text.leader_trait_peacekeeper_desc: This leader recognizes that to keep the peace one must cast a wide net. The best admirals are on the lookout for those dissidents, pirates, and petty criminals who aim to exploit our trade routes.
text.leader_trait_nervous_desc: This leader is nervous and apprehensive, and is easily overwhelmed commanding large formations of starships.
text.leader_trait_lethargic_desc: This leader is slow and indolent, performing duties with little energy or initiative.
text.leader_trait_micromanager_desc: This leader can only control a limited fleet, as they demand to oversee every detail of its operation.
text.leader_trait_reckless_desc: This leader is reckless and disregards any safety procedures during combat, pushing ships to their limit.
text.leader_trait_slipshod_desc: This leader lacks the organizational skills to maintain their fleet to combat readiness.
text.leader_trait_dragonslayer_desc: This Commander has proven themselves in fierce combat.
text.leader_trait_clone_army_commander_desc: From its extensive military education, this leader understands how to maximize the efficiency of ships and soldiers alike.
text.leader_trait_clone_army_fertile_commande: From its specialized military education, this leader holds an above-average understanding of martial procedures and how best to optimize them.
text.leader_trait_clone_army_full_commander_d: Subjected since its creation to a military education regimen so intense few could endure it, this leader wields excellent martial and leadership abilities.
text.leader_trait_tactical_algorithms_desc: This leader enhances combat efficiency and repair rates by directly integrating with ship systems, albeit at a higher energy cost.
text.leader_trait_tactical_algorithms_tt: $t$The effects of this trait scale with §YLeader Skill Level§!
text.leader_trait_shroudwalker_desc: An adept of the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName], skilled in instructing in the ways of the Shroud.
text.leader_trait_master_salvager_desc: A veteran of Salvage operations from the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], sharing their expertise for a small fee.

text.leader_trait_curator_desc: This leader hails from the Curator Order. Their understanding of technology and exploration is unmatched.
text.leader_trait_curator_effect: $t$Increases the chance to draw Rare Technologies.
text.leader_trait_enclave_trader_desc: Recruited from one of the independent merchant Enclaves, this leader is particularly adept at maximizing Trade.
text.leader_trait_xuracorp_liaison_desc: Recruited from XuraCorp, this leader holds shares in several Exotic Gas production facilities.
text.leader_trait_riggan_liaison_desc: Recruited from the Riggan Commerce Exchange, this leader spends their spare time dealing in Volatile Mote futures.
text.leader_trait_muutagan_liaison_desc: Recruited from the Muutagan Merchant Guild, this leader owns several private Rare Crystal mines.
text.leader_trait_defence_engineer_desc: This leader focuses on making orbital defenses into an impenetrable wall of death against potential invasion forces.
text.leader_trait_butcher_desc: This leader is ruthless, giving no quarter to the enemy.
text.leader_trait_restrained_desc: This leader is concerned with minimizing loss and avoiding unnecessary deaths among soldiers and non-combatants.
text.leader_trait_dreaded_desc: This leader fills their enemies with dread.
text.leader_trait_heavy_hitter_desc: This leader employs rapid dominance during ground combat.
text.leader_trait_interrogator_desc: This leader will attempt to extract valuable information from enemy prisoners.
text.leader_trait_interrogator_effect:
$ARMY_EFFECTS_TXT$:
$t$On Winning Ground Combat as Attacker:
$tt$ $INTEL$ on enemy Empire: §G+15§!
text.leader_trait_interrogator_2_effect:
$ARMY_EFFECTS_TXT$:
$t$On Winning Ground Combat as Attacker:
$tt$ $INTEL$ on enemy Empire: §G+30§!
text.leader_trait_crusader_desc: This leader is focused on destroying our enemies. [Root.GetHisHerCap] dedication to the cause is unwavering
text.leader_trait_overseer_desc: This leader focuses on maintaining order and loyalty among vassal empires.
text.trait_ruler_from_the_ranks_desc: This leader rose through the ranks of military command.
text.trait_ruler_recruiter_desc: This leader is particularly charismatic, and fresh recruits are practically lining up to serve their nation.
text.leader_trait_consul_general_desc: This leader is responsible for maintaining diplomatic protocols.
text.leader_trait_shadow_broker_desc: This leader keeps a network of clandestine operatives at their disposal.
text.leader_trait_home_guard_desc: This leader's elaborate planetary defense systems are a good preparation against enemy invasion.
text.leader_trait_hardy_desc: This leader conducts quality training exercises to ensure their troops are always in prime physical condition.
text.leader_trait_martinet_desc: This governor demands absolute obedience, making it difficult for any potential gangs and dissidents to thrive.
text.leader_trait_warden_desc: This leader likes to boost their forces with planetary volunteers and mercenaries.
text.leader_trait_reinforcer_desc: This leader focuses on building emergency bomb shelters and reinforced bunkers in case of orbital bombardment.
text.leader_trait_guardian_desc: This leader focuses on maintaining starbase defenses to bolster system security.
text.leader_trait_conscripter_desc: This leader knows how to handle recruits and streamline the process of enlisting new volunteers into the army.
text.leader_trait_taskmaster_desc: Taskmasters focus not only on strategy, but the minutia of every soldier's daily routine.
text.leader_trait_fortress_cracker_desc: It takes a combination of force, cunning, and experience to topple a well-designed defensive structure. This commander takes pleasure in the challenge and succeeds where others would give it up as a lost cause.
text.leader_trait_chainbreaker_desc: No sentient being should be enslaved and exploited for the profit of others. This leader's reputation precedes them, with the enslaved and oppressed gladly taking up arms when called.
text.leader_trait_chainbreaker_effect: $t$70% chance to spawn §G1§! Army per §Y$pop_cat_slave$§! on attacked planet
text.leader_trait_honored_warmaster_desc: Warmasters are commanders of renown. This leader instills pride and courage, making people eager to grab a weapon and enlist.
text.leader_trait_academia_recruiter_desc: At our academic institutions, recruiters are extolling the virtues of military service to our best and brightest minds. The practical experience gained on the battlefield can't be taught in a classroom, and should lead to advances in engineering and technology.
text.leader_trait_supreme_warrior_desc: This leader is one of the few commanders to have attained this title. They lead their troops in person, inspiring allies and overwhelming even the toughest of foes.
text.leader_trait_spymaster_desc: Far from a simple spy, this leader spins a web of informants, smugglers, and assassins. When something needs doing quietly, this can prove an enormous asset.
text.leader_trait_totalitarian_desc: A title of honor and repute, the Herald is a master player in the great game of nations. Such diplomats provide a trusted link between an overlord and its vassals.
text.leader_trait_bellicose_desc: With a genius for logistics, this commander maintains the efficiency of military operations with deceptively simple solutions.
text.leader_trait_armchair_commander_desc: This leader commands from the rear, which demoralizes front-line troops.
text.leader_trait_uninspiring_desc: This leader lacks charisma and makes no effort to reward or encourage, leaving their soldiers demotivated.
text.leader_trait_slothful_desc: This leader's reluctance to organize training drills affects [Root.GetHisHer] army's combat prowess.
text.leader_trait_victory_or_death_desc: This leader has no respect for their soldiers' lives, willing to throw them away for honor and little else.
text.leader_trait_disorganized_desc: This leader's lack of organizational skills causes their troops to function more like a war band than a proper military.
text.leader_trait_lawless_desc: This leader is in the pocket of local gangs and pirates.
text.leader_trait_tzrynn_tithe_desc: On Tzynnia it is customary for the winner of any conflict to take a third of whatever the loser values most. Gia'Zumon keeps this tradition alive.
text.leader_trait_kidnapper_3_effect:
$ARMY_EFFECTS_TXT$:
$t$On Winning Ground Combat as Attacker:
$tt$Abduct §YPops§! as §YSlaves§! to Random Colonies: §G30%§!
text.leader_trait_adventurous_spirit_desc: This leader has a yearning for adventure and an overt distaste for boardroom politics.
text.leader_trait_eager_desc: This leader is particularly eager for an assignment.
text.leader_trait_opportunity_custom_effect: Does not use Leader Capacity while under Level 4.
text.leader_trait_resilient_desc: This leader is resilient and in excellent physical condition, increasing their life expectancy.
text.leader_trait_adaptable_desc: This leader is quick to adopt new methods and ideas that prove superior.
text.leader_trait_politician_desc: This leader has an affinity for politics, and is well-versed when it comes to fiery debates.
text.leader_trait_capitalist_desc: This leader is a major player in the competitive energy market.
text.leader_trait_private_mines_desc: This leader owns and maintains private sources of minerals.
text.leader_trait_homesteader_desc: This leader has plots of land dedicated to the production of food.
text.trait_ruler_champion_of_the_people_desc: This leader appears to genuinely care about their subjects.
text.leader_trait_gifted_desc: This leader has a quick mind, grasping demanding concepts with ease.
text.leader_trait_scrapper_desc: This leader possesses and operates private scavenging drones.
text.leader_trait_entrepreneur_desc: This leader has an enterprising mind, designing and producing impressive amounts of goods.
text.leader_trait_venerated_desc: This leader is highly respected by others.
text.leader_trait_emotional_support_pet_desc: The warm cuddles of this adorable creature offer comfort from the horrors of space.
text.leader_trait_educator_desc: Knowledge and experience are the foundation of every great society. This leader possesses these values and does everything to promote and encourage them in others.
text.leader_trait_master_bureaucrat_desc: Having toiled as a bureaucrat, this leader is a master of paperwork. With everything correctly filed, more time can be devoted to their subordinates.
text.leader_trait_fallible_desc: This leader is incapable of resisting temptation and can not stay out of trouble.
text.leader_trait_substance_abuser_desc: This leader has fallen to substance abuse to cope with stress, which has had a detrimental effect on their physical health.
text.leader_trait_stubborn_desc: This leader is stubborn and slow to accept new methods and ideas, even if they have proven superior.
text.leader_trait_melancholic_desc: This leader suffers extended bouts of sadness.
text.leader_trait_lavish_lifestyle_desc: This leader has a weakness for beautiful, expensive things.
text.leader_trait_excessive_desc: This leader indulges in hoarding goods for [Root.GetHisHer] personal use.
text.leader_trait_arrested_development_desc: The personal development and skills of this leader seem to have plateaued.
text.leader_trait_reclusive_desc: This leader does not like to be at the center of attention. Or to be the recipient of any attention at all, for that matter.
text.leader_trait_embezzler_desc: This leader does not believe anyone would notice if small amounts of credits go missing.
text.leader_trait_intolerant_desc: This leader views anyone different from [Root.GetHimHer] with suspicion and distrust.
text.leader_trait_gullible_desc: This leader believes almost anything they read from an official looking source.
text.leader_trait_volatile_desc: This leader is infamous for [Root.GetHisHer] erratic temperament.
text.leader_trait_passive_desc: This leader has such a subdued personality, [Root.GetSheHe] is barely noticed.
text.leader_trait_tyrannical_desc: This leader is known for treating [Root.GetHisHer] subordinates in cruel and oppressive ways.
text.leader_trait_bureaucratic_desc: This leader believes proper processes and duplicated paper trails are the marks of a well-run empire.
text.leader_trait_intemporal_desc: This leader is unaffected by time and will not die from old age.
text.trait_ruler_frontier_spirit_desc: This leader is eager to reign over distant stars.
text.leader_trait_intellectual_desc: This leader is naturally interested in the sciences and seeks to foster a curiosity about the natural world in their subjects.
text.leader_trait_bureaucrat_desc: This leader excels at inter-government diplomacy and consensus building.
text.leader_trait_army_veteran_desc: A veteran, this leader gives the army preferential treatment in their sector.
text.leader_trait_retired_fleet_officer_desc: A former fleet officer, this leader actively supports shipyards under their administration.
text.leader_trait_agrarian_upbringing_desc: Raised in a farming zone, this leader is interested in optimizing yields.
text.trait_ruler_fertility_preacher_desc: This leader excels in acquiring vital resources for a burgeoning population.
text.leader_trait_righteous_desc: This leader has strong convictions about law and order.
text.leader_trait_iron_fist_desc: This leader is infamous for their ruthless pursuit of efficiency, and is capable of getting the most out of slave labor.
text.leader_trait_environmental_engineer_desc: This leader has expertise in cutting edge geo-sculpting processes and cost-saving techniques.
text.leader_trait_enlister_desc: This leader is a master of military propaganda. Recruits are added to the ranks swiftly and efficiently.
text.leader_trait_shipwright_desc: This leader is skilled at military ship design.
text.leader_trait_architectural_interest_desc: This leader cultivates a strong interest in architecture and construction techniques.
text.leader_trait_trade_focus_desc: This leader has a keen understanding of bargaining techniques, which allows for the acquisition of profitable contracts.
text.leader_trait_frontier_spirit_desc: This leader yearns to stake out distant systems.
text.leader_trait_cultural_focus_desc: This leader has a keen interest in promoting cultural growth and artistic endeavors.
text.trait_ruler_investor_desc: This leader is a shrewd economist, capable of maximizing financial potential.
text.trait_ruler_architectural_sense_desc: This leader is an architect at heart, investing in more efficient construction practices.
text.trait_ruler_deep_connections_desc: This leader is firmly entrenched in the labyrinthine web that makes up the political machine.
text.leader_trait_reformer_desc: This leader is a reformer, dedicated towards building the society of tomorrow.
text.leader_trait_courtroom_training_desc: A natural ability in Xenolinguistics has allowed this leader to be able to expertly communicate when interacting with aliens.
text.leader_trait_mining_focus_desc: This leader has a keen understanding of mining processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.
text.only_one_governor_focus: §YOnly one Governor focus can be selected.§!
text.leader_trait_generator_focus_desc: This leader has a keen understanding of energy generation processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.
text.leader_trait_farming_focus_desc: This leader has a keen understanding of farming processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.
text.leader_trait_settler_desc: This leader ensures comfortable living conditions and plentiful supplies for all who dwell under their care.
text.leader_trait_cartographer_desc: An expert in geo-mapping, this leader can recognize the faintest potential in new worlds.
text.leader_trait_naturalist_desc: This leader is keen on finding new ways to use planetary resources and increase their benefit to the empire.
text.leader_trait_forge_focus_desc: This leader has a keen understanding of forging processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.
text.leader_trait_industrial_focus_desc: This leader has a keen understanding of industrial processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.
text.leader_trait_refinement_focus_desc: This leader has a keen understanding of refining processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.
text.leader_trait_urbanist_desc: This leader excels in making sure megacities and industrial complexes are logistically connected.
text.leader_trait_assembler_desc: As an authority on robotics, this leader knows how to make artificial bodies more efficiently than most.
text.leader_trait_pop_focused_desc: This leader knows the value and importance of an experienced support staff.
text.leader_trait_distribution_lines_desc: This leader is keen on streamlining distribution lines for industrial complexes.
text.leader_trait_efficient_desc: Born into the higher echelons of society, this leader has a strong sense of their own worth, and tends to favor peers of the upper classes.
text.leader_trait_arbiter_desc: With an iron hand and complete indifference toward safety regulations, this leader drives output at the cost of lowering life expectancy and the occasional mass strike. However, with the right amount of force, such nuisances are easily dealt with.
text.leader_trait_utopian_idealist_desc: Many dream of building a truly utopian society. This leader works to turn those dreams into a reality.
text.leader_trait_mediator_desc: A skilled mediator is essential in highly diverse population centers. This leader knows how to defuse tension and efficiently manage a multi-species colony.

text.leader_trait_shroud_preacher_desc: The Shroud encompasses every living being. Connected to the powers within, this leader fosters true devotion in their followers.
text.leader_trait_master_diplomat_desc: After many years working with diplomats in foreign embassies, this leader knows how to navigate cultural nuances, masterfully managing a network of high-ranking officials from neighboring empires.
text.leader_trait_supreme_organizer_desc: With strict control over matters of state, this leader resides at the center of a labyrinthian set of rules, laws, and bureaucratic procedures, all designed to enhance their own power.
text.leader_trait_galvanizer_desc: Having a strong sense of purpose leads to many positive outcomes. This leader knows how to handle the populace, giving them a common goal to pursue with energy.
text.leader_trait_corrupt_desc: This leader is willing to bend the law for personal benefit.
text.leader_trait_polluter_desc: This leader's blatant disregard for the environment worsens living conditions.
text.leader_trait_sadistic_desc: This leader is harsh with their subordinates, affecting [Root.GetHisHer] ability to retain qualified colonial staff.
text.leader_trait_profligate_desc: This leader is reckless in the storage and acquisition of goods and supplies.
text.leader_trait_procrastinator_desc: This leader prefers to spend their time on non-essential tasks.
text.leader_trait_insider_trading_desc: This leader is willing to employ less-than-legal trading practices to accumulate personal wealth.
text.leader_trait_irenic_desc: This leader works obsessively to safeguard against perceived military overreach.
text.leader_trait_shroud_prophet_desc: It is said this unit has a deep connection with the Shroud, as well as the entities that exist therein.
text.trait_ruler_space_miner_desc: This leader recognizes just how vital the exploitation of offworld resources is for a star nation.
text.trait_ruler_home_in_the_sky_desc: This leader reaches for the stars.
text.leader_trait_carefree_desc: This leader is perhaps less meticulous than others.
text.leader_trait_roamer_desc: This leader was born to roam the stars.
text.leader_trait_archaeologist_desc: This leader excels at the study of alien artifacts and structural remnants in the field.
text.leader_trait_meticulous_desc: This leader is thorough in their examinations of unknown phenomena.
text.leader_trait_custom_AI_assistant_desc: This leader has created a simple neural network to help with data processing tasks.
text.leader_trait_sapient_AI_assistant_desc: This leader has created a complex neural network capable of independent decision-making and even introspection.
text.leader_trait_slippery_desc: Exploring the unknown is a dangerous task. This leader upgraded [Root.GetHisHer] ship with additional fail-safe systems and automatic FTL-disengagement protocols.
text.leader_trait_prospector_desc: This leader has a set of self-built, powerful scanners, which can find even the deepest deposits when surveying galactic objects.
text.leader_trait_observant_desc: A set of self-built, powerful scanners allow this leader to see further and plan the journey ahead.
text.leader_trait_academic_dig_site_expert_de: This leader is no stranger to physical labor and finds field work particularly enjoyable.
text.leader_trait_academic_minor_artifacts_ex: Where other academics see trash, this scholar sees treasures. This meticulous leader never leaves an archaeological site before examining every scrap.
text.leader_trait_tuner_desc: By investing in top-of-the-line upgrades for civilian vessel engines, this leader managed to improve their vessel's cruising speed.
text.leader_trait_explorer_cloaking_focus_des: Some discoveries are best kept hidden.
text.leader_trait_collaborator_desc: This leader facilitates collaboration between scientists and researchers across a range of fields in the pursuit of knowledge.
text.leader_trait_manufacturer_desc: This leader works hard to implement new techniques for the mass production of low-cost goods.

text.leader_trait_space_miner_desc: This leader can identify rich ore veins for planetside mining facilities.
text.leader_trait_inquisitive_desc: This leader possesses a highly inquisitive mind, always trying to find another field of research to explore and study.
text.leader_trait_maniacal_desc: This leader pursues their research with unusual fervor.
text.trait_ruler_expansionist_desc: This leader is driven to push the empire's reach ever further into the stars.
text.leader_trait_science_communicator_desc: Storing and cataloging data is a continuous and never-ending task. This leader makes sure that others can easily derive knowledge from the archives.
text.leader_trait_engineering_focus_desc: This leader is passionate about advancing research in deep space engineering, design, and voidcraft. Their knowledge in these fields is unparalleled.
text.leader_trait_physics_focus_desc: This leader's keen mind is focused on advancing the field of physics. Our research related to particles and new computing mechanisms will bloom under their guidance.
text.leader_trait_society_focus_desc: Having a deep knowledge of the intricacies of civilization, this leader will guide us into a new era with their focus on societal matters.
text.leader_trait_expertise_materials_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Materials.
text.leader_trait_expertise_propulsion_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Propulsion.
text.leader_trait_expertise_voidcraft_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Voidcraft.
text.leader_trait_expertise_industry_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Industry.
text.leader_trait_expertise_field_manipulatio: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Field Manipulation.
text.leader_trait_expertise_particles_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Particles.
text.leader_trait_expertise_computing_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Computing.
text.leader_trait_expertise_psionics_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Psionics.
text.leader_trait_expertise_new_worlds_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert on settling on New Worlds.
text.leader_trait_expertise_statecraft_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Statecraft.
text.leader_trait_expertise_biology_desc: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Biology.
text.leader_trait_expertise_military_theory_d: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Military Theory.
text.leader_trait_expertise_archaeostudies_de: This leader is, following years of study, considered an expert within the field of Archaeostudies.
text.leader_trait_surveyor_desc: Advanced surveying techniques and machinery demand wide-ranging field experience. This leader's expertise has turned planetary surveying into an art form.
text.leader_trait_midas_touch_desc: Often off-world, this leader has borne witness to truly amazing, far-flung places. [Root.GetHisHer] exploits inspire the populace, providing valuable insights into rare resources and anomalous occurrences.
text.leader_trait_midas_touch_effect:
On Researching any Anomaly:
$tt$All $scientist_plural_with_icon$ gain §G+300§! experience
text.leader_trait_collective_wisdom_desc: A meticulous academic who works slowly, but produces incredible amounts of research.
text.leader_trait_knowledge_for_the_masses_de: Nothing is more important than a proper education. This leader spares no effort to cultivate young minds, aided by a devoted following of graduates.
text.leader_trait_robotist_desc: This leader is a champion of robot design and manufacturing processes, always pushing the boundaries of what is possible. If there are advancements in robotics at hand, this individual likely had something to do with it.
text.leader_trait_great_researcher_desc: In rare cases, a single person can outperform an entire team of researchers. When it comes to experimental designs, new solutions, and new technologies, this leader is a true genius.
text.leader_trait_xeno_cataloger_desc: This leader is tasked with discovering, identifying, and cataloging all xeno lifeforms. The data is then assessed to determine any possible threats and future contamination protocols.
text.leader_trait_frontier_adventurer_desc: Exploring new systems, finding new worlds, and discovering long-forgotten civilizations are the main concerns of any true adventurer. This leader is the very embodiment of this ideal, always on the lookout for lost knowledge or forgotten ruins.
text.leader_trait_brilliant_shipwright_desc: With extensive knowledge and an innate understanding of shipbuilding, this leader is responsible not only for new technology but also for overseeing our shipyards.
text.leader_trait_truth_seeker_desc: To pursue the truth is to open one's mind to possibilities beyond the horizon; perhaps beyond the veil of reality itself. This leader has a deep desire to uncover every secret of the universe, no matter the risks.
text.leader_trait_paranoid_desc: This leader is unwilling to collaborate with others.
text.leader_trait_narrow_minded_desc: This leader has a very narrow focus on potential research, disregarding some options as unnecessary.
text.leader_trait_neurotic_desc: This leader takes too many precautions, with a complete disregard for efficiency.
text.leader_trait_opinionated_desc: This leader keeps strong opinions on certain topics, making collaboration with other researchers difficult.
text.leader_trait_destructive_desc: This leader neglects the care of spacecraft and machinery, leading to frequent repairs and ongoing maintenance to keep them operational.
text.leader_trait_towel_desc: A towel has immense psychological value.
text.leader_trait_percussive_maintainer_desc: There is no such thing as a hardware problem that liberal use of the boot will not fix.
text.leader_trait_guided_desc: This unit navigates the galaxy based on visions and messages from the Shroud. It needs a constant supply of Zro to keep the signals clear and comprehensible.
text.leader_trait_shroud_age_desc: The powerful psionic energies of the Shroud have slowed the natural [GetAgingLoc] process of this [GetLeaderLoc].
text.leader_trait_erudite_desc: This leader possesses a vast intellect and a deep pool of knowledge.
text.leader_trait_cyborg_desc: This leader has been heavily augmented with cybernetic implants.
text.leader_trait_synthetic_desc: This synthetic leader is equipped with a large collection of assorted upgrades.
text.leader_trait_psionic_desc: This leader possesses powerful psionic abilities.
text.leader_trait_whisperers_chosen_desc: This leader has been chosen to wield the power of an inscrutable Shroud entity. Sustained by psionic energies, death is now foreign to them.
text.leader_trait_mercenary_warrior_desc: This leader hails from a space-based warrior culture, and has been taught unorthodox hit-and-run tactics from an early age.
text.leader_trait_ruler_hive_mind_desc: This leader is the immortal nexus of the vast cognitive apparatus that constitutes a [owner.GetGestaltEntityName].
text.leader_trait_ignore_leader_cap_tt: Does not count towards Leader Capacity
text.leader_trait_ruler_machine_intelligence_: This leader is the core intelligence that oversees and directs all actions in a Machine Empire.
text.leader_trait_ancient_knowledge_desc: This leader wields insights gathered centuries before many civilizations could even begin to comprehend space.
text.leader_trait_hacked_desc: This Leader is compromised, their neurological wetware hacked by an unknown source.
text.leader_trait_firewalled_desc: While safe from cyber attacks, our leaders are less effective learners.
text.leader_trait_virtual_desc: This virtual leader has unparalleled access to a wide range of advanced algorithms.
text.leader_trait_principled_desc: This leader has a strict code and follows our empire's morals, setting a good example for others.
text.leader_trait_fleet_organizer_desc: This leader is an expert at organization, having the necessary micromanagement skills to command very large starship formations.
text.leader_trait_spycraft_desc: Some commanders prefer to use more subtle methods by employing spies and informants rather than brute strength.
text.leader_trait_spark_of_genius_desc: This leader is prone to sudden bursts of inspiration.
text.trait_ruler_industrialist_desc: This leader has a firm focus on increasing mining output.
text.trait_ruler_warlike_desc: This leader does not shy away from conflict.
text.trait_ruler_charismatic_desc: This leader is exceptionally charismatic, enforcing their will with ease.
text.trait_ruler_feedback_loop_desc: Efficient feedback loops and action-reaction analysis make this unit far better at predicting outcomes.
text.trait_ruler_logistic_understanding_desc: This leader is well aware of the importance of properly-structured supply chains.
text.trait_ruler_eye_for_talent_desc: This leader is considered to be unusually perceptive, spotting talent where others see only eccentricity or incompetence.
text.leader_trait_admiral_hells_heart_desc: When it comes to warfare, this leader is mercilessly obsessive, and singular in purpose.
text.leader_trait_admiral_warform_desc: The blessing of the Animator of Clay has allowed the warform to survive in the most hostile conditions, and adapt to its corrosive environment.
text.leader_trait_admiral_warform_node_desc: The unique knowledge of the warform has become our own.
text.leader_trait_governor_gray_desc: Gray is a dense swarm of billions of advanced nanites.
text.leader_trait_govenor_caretaker_desc: Ensuring nutrients are available, that the workspace is clean, and that the wards are properly stimulated all fall under the purview of a Caretaker.
text.leader_trait_govenor_caretaker_node_desc: The unique knowledge of the Caretaker has become our own.
text.leader_trait_caravan_counter_desc: This leader has ample experience stopping the flighty Caravaneer fleets dead in their tracks.
text.leader_trait_waste_management_specialist: This leader has an almost uncanny ability to reduce and repurpose industrial waste. How do they do it? It's best not to ask.
text.leader_trait_nuumismatic_priest_desc: A level nine Shakvah with enhanced mind focus and inner gaze...
text.leader_trait_traumatized_desc: Recently sustained psychological trauma is interfering with this leader's performance.
text.leader_trait_maimed_desc: This leader has sustained irreversible physical injury that has lowered their life expectancy significantly.
text.leader_trait_inspired_archaeologist_desc: This leader has had a sudden stroke of inspiration.
text.leader_trait_bulwark_watcher_desc: Vigilant crews stand ready to detect enemy fleets daring to attempt furtive and cowardly incursions.
text.leader_trait_bulwark_retaliator_desc: With a righteous commander at the helm, fleets stand ready to avenge any insult to our sovereignty.
text.leader_trait_bulwark_sentinel_desc: Courageous crews hold the line against invaders, ready to repel anyone foolish enough to invade our domain!
text.leader_trait_scholarium_investigator_des: Scholarium specialists view the universe as one large puzzle, waiting to be solved.
text.leader_trait_scholarium_explorer_desc: The curiosity of Scholarium specialists will drive them to the ends of the universe, and probably beyond.
text.leader_trait_scholarium_observer_desc: No mystery shall be left unsolved in a Scholarium scholar's wake.
text.leader_trait_prospectorium_extractor_des: Energy, alloys, and minerals all empower our ambitions. Extractors maximize their acquisition.
text.leader_trait_prospectorium_optimizer_des: Keeping a populace healthy and productive requires resources, and optimizers are ideally suited to manage them.
text.leader_trait_prospectorium_refiner_desc: Refiners have the rarefied expertise necessary to improve our acquisition of exotic gases, motes, and crystals.
text.leader_trait_admiral_mind_wipe_01_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this commander's mind now swirls with new ideas to enhance ship performance.
text.leader_trait_admiral_mind_wipe_02_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this commander's mind now swirls with new ideas to enhance weapon systems.
text.leader_trait_general_mind_wipe_01_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this commander's mind now swirls with new ideas to increase the potency of our armies.
text.leader_trait_general_mind_wipe_02_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this commander's mind now swirls with new ideas to enhance the performance of our armies.
text.leader_trait_scientist_mind_wipe_01_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this scientist's mind now swirls with new ideas to boost research performance.
text.leader_trait_scientist_mind_wipe_02_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this scientist's mind now swirls with new ideas to assist archaeological research.
text.leader_trait_ruler_mind_wipe_01_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this leader's mind now swirls with new ideas to assist construction efforts.
text.leader_trait_ruler_mind_wipe_02_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this leader's mind now swirls with new ideas to boost fleet performance.
text.gestalt_trait_commander_mind_wipe_01_des: $shroud_touched_intro$ this drone is now capable of enhancing ship performance.
text.gestalt_trait_commander_mind_wipe_02_des: $shroud_touched_intro$ this drone is now capable of enhancing weapon systems.
text.gestalt_trait_general_mind_wipe_01_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this drone's uplink to our armies has been enhanced.
text.gestalt_trait_general_mind_wipe_02_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this drone's uplink to our armies has been improved.
text.gestalt_trait_scientist_mind_wipe_02_des: $shroud_touched_intro$ this drone is now capable of enhanced archaeological research.
text.gestalt_trait_ruler_mind_wipe_01_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ this drone is now capable of enhancing our construction techniques.
text.gestalt_trait_ruler_mind_wipe_02_desc: $shroud_touched_intro$ is now capable of boosting fleet performance.
text.leader_trait_ambassador_ear_to_the_groun: This leader has eyes everywhere. Plus [root.species.GetEarNamePlural]. And other assorted sensory organs.
text.leader_trait_ambassador_whisper_networks: Feigning a penchant for gossip, this official is a master at forming contacts with loose-lipped leaders in high places.
text.leader_trait_ambassador_bully_desc: Spite can be a powerful motivator. This leader has mastered the art of turning bitter complaints into calls to action.
text.leader_trait_ambassador_favor_maker_desc: This sly ambassador is quick to turn every perceived slight into blackmail material.
text.leader_trait_ambassador_favor_maker_effe: $EMPIRE_EFFECTS_TXT$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Envoys §YImproving Relations§! have a §G0.25%§! chance each month of acquiring a §YFavor§!
text.leader_trait_ambassador_favor_maker_2_ef: $EMPIRE_EFFECTS_TXT$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Envoys §YImproving Relations§! have a §G0.50%§! chance each month of acquiring a §YFavor§!
text.leader_trait_ambassador_favor_maker_3_ef: $EMPIRE_EFFECTS_TXT$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Envoys §YImproving Relations§! have a §G1%§! chance each month of acquiring a §YFavor§!
text.leader_trait_ambassador_pact_keeper_desc: Graceful manners help this leader gain favorable conditions when negotiating diplomatic agreements.
text.leader_trait_ambassador_commercial_pact_: The market is not a warzone: it's a party. By working together, we can all make a profit.
text.leader_trait_ambassador_research_pact_fo: Sharing knowledge. Sharing viewpoints. Sharing research. Building the future, together.
text.leader_trait_ambassador_extra_envoys_des: This leader likes to surround [root.GetHerselfHimself] with specially trained assistants.
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_commerc: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Galactic Commerce.
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_industr: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Industrial Development.
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_politic: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Politics Traditions.
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_greater: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to The Greater Good.
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_galacti: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Galactic Reforms.
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_ecology: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Ecological Protection.
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_galacti: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Unchained Knowledge.
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_divinit: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Divinity of Life.
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_mutuald: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Mutual Defense.
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_rulesof: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Rules of War.
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_defense: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Defense Privatization.
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_interga: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Intergalactic Directives.
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_bureauc: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Bureaucratic Surveillance.
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_pre_ftl: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Pre-FTL Stance.
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_sanctio: This delegate takes a special interest in all matters related to Galactic Sanctions.
text.leader_trait_federal_negotiator_desc: This leader firmly believes in the uniting power of Federations. [Root.GetHisHer] dedication is an inspiration for us all.
text.leader_trait_federal_greeter_desc: This delegate is quick to greet new Federation members and knows how to make them feel part of the group.
text.leader_trait_federal_sweet_talker_desc: We may have different beliefs, but we share the same goal, the same Federation, the same dreams. Conflict only makes us weak.
text.leader_trait_federal_joint_navy_desc: Unity is strength. Sometimes, that strength is inside us. Sometimes, it just means having a bigger fleet.
text.leader_trait_diplo_weight_desc: There's a certain... something in the way this leader behaves that commands respect. When this delegate speaks, everyone stops to listen.
text.leader_trait_supporting_voter_desc: This leader is always eager to congratulate others for their success.
text.leader_trait_supporting_voter_tt: £diplo_weight£ §Y[GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]§! §EEffects§!:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Support for a passed Resolution grants 1 §YFavor§! and 5 §YTrust§! with the proposing empire
text.leader_trait_gorky_desc: This little assistant helps out with sorting data and analyzing it. Its AI is a unique mix of research and companion bots.
text.leader_trait_legendary_leader_desc:
§GThe Luminary grows in power over time.§!

The Unification Wars were a brutal affair. In the end, [Root.GetName] brought peace and purpose to us all. The Luminary is the living symbol of what our species can achieve, and an inspiration to all.[This.Paragon_Origin_Ascension_Desc]
text.leader_trait_legendary_offspring_desc: The Heir to the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$. Living up to their predecessor's legacy will be a challenge, but this leader already shows great promise.
text.leader_trait_governor_psionic_communion_: This leader's psionic abilities improve the populace's mental wellbeing, building trust and providing a sense of safety.
text.leader_trait_legendary_terraformation_nu:
The buds on §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$'s§! back. She is secretive about them.
§HThree buds remain.§!

The buds on §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$'s§! back. Her health seems reliant on them.
§HTwo buds remain.§!

The buds on §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$'s§! back, and the source of her powers. Azaryn needs them to survive.
§RA single bud remains.§!
text.leader_trait_legendary_far_from_home_des: Where does he come from? Who placed him in cryostasis, and why was he released? The unanswered questions of his past fuel this leader's thirst for knowledge.
text.leader_trait_legendary_ancestors_knowled: This leader's body is itself a vast storehouse of knowledge and skill; a genetic inheritance granted by the sacrifice of his ancestors.
text.leader_trait_legendary_military_knowledg: A brilliant military commander, loved by the troops.
text.leader_trait_legendary_foe_hammer_desc: An expert in starship weapons systems, this leader brings invaluable knowledge to fleet warfare.
text.leader_trait_legendary_great_teacher_des: This leader displays exceptional educational skills, and will help others to reach their full potential.
text.leader_trait_legendary_pious_ascet_desc: This leader is a model of self-discipline, and an inspiration to all.
text.leader_trait_legendary_commanding_presen: Authority comes naturally to this leader, and few dare contest their decisions.
text.leader_trait_legendary_high_king_desc: By merit alone, this leader earned the respect and loyalty of the other noble houses.
text.leader_trait_legendary_gunboat_diplomacy: This leader favors displays of power. A well-placed threat is sometimes worth a thousand words.
text.leader_trait_legendary_scientific_diplom: By offering the best, we can attract the brightest minds. This leader specializes in the recruitment of qualified personnel.
text.leader_trait_legendary_autarky_desc: This leader will strive to ensure the nation's self-sufficiency.
text.leader_trait_legendary_natural_ruler_des: Charismatic, caring and selfless, this leader seeks to improve quality of life for all.
text.leader_trait_legendary_industry_titan_de: This leader sees a healthy economy as the foundation of any great nation.
text.leader_trait_legendary_great_inventor_de: This leader is a pioneer in robotics and our lead researcher in workforce automation.
text.leader_trait_legendary_genetic_purist_de: This leader's flair for genetic manipulation is legendary.
text.leader_trait_legendary_evervigilant_desc: This leader is extremely rigorous with security and encryption protocols, and personally oversees our intelligence department.
text.leader_trait_legendary_unfriendly_desc: Callous and very direct, this leader regularly makes diplomatic blunders.
text.leader_trait_legendary_warmonger_desc: Provocative and adversarial, this leader enjoys conflict, be it social or martial.
text.leader_trait_legendary_dreamlike_desc: This leader is easily distracted and often forgets about less important tasks.
text.leader_trait_legendary_harsh_ruler_desc: This leader's answer to any issue is brutal oppression, which alienates the local population.
text.leader_trait_legendary_too_open_desc: This leader is too trusting and forgiving. Others find it easy to abuse these qualities.
text.leader_trait_legendary_hoplofobia_desc: Terrified of risks, this leader is overly cautious, and implements excessive checks and redundancies in their workflow.
text.leader_trait_legendary_bad_meritocracy_d: This leader abhors mediocrity, often dismissing talented people for even the slightest mistake.
text.leader_trait_legendary_delusional_desc: This leader's paranoid delusions are driving [Root.GetHimHer] towards isolation.
text.leader_trait_the_apparatus_luminary_desc: Immortality, but at what cost? This leader is bound to a cumbersome life-sustaining apparatus in the council chambers.
text.leader_trait_the_cybernetic_luminary_des: Immortality is achievable. Due to several advanced upgrades, this leader can sync directly with every high-level cybernetic administrator. However, this does limit their ability to learn independently.
text.leader_trait_the_psionic_luminary_desc: The price of immortality is high... The Shroud Entity left a doorway in the mind of this leader. The Entity has gained a foothold in our realm, and the leader must be supplied with a constant supply of Zro.
text.leader_trait_the_synth_luminary_desc: This leader's synthetic body is the epitome of the roboticist's art. Quantum processing grants a direct connection with the meta-continuousness of the people. While boosting efficiency, the effects do not bode well for those altered.
text.leader_trait_the_genetic_luminary_desc: An endless series of clones has granted this leader immortality. Should the current sleeve become damaged or obsolete, a dozen more are ready to take its place. This has led to an obsession with genetic perfection.
text.leader_trait_unholy_node_desc: The $NAME_Apostate$ taught us how to hate.
text.leader_trait_fotd_scientist_desc: This scientist's experience has resulted in valuable insights into cloaking tech.
text.leader_trait_fotd_scientist_tooltip: Has increased chance to discover §HCloaking Technologies§! insights related to physics.
text.leader_trait_fotd_commander_desc: This commander's upbringing taught them to use cloaking in ways our own commanders could never imagine.
text.leader_trait_preftl_haggler_desc: Coming from a [Owner.GetPreFTLUpper] country, this leader has displayed an exceptionally keen mind for business.
text.leader_trait_zealot_desc: Having gazed into the abyss, this leader possesses unshakeable faith.
text.leader_trait_plague_hardened_desc: Having gazed into the abyss, this commander possesses a keen and tempered mind.
text.leader_trait_rift_warped_desc: This leader has crossed the astral planes; the effects of such a journey are both lasting and profound.
text.leader_trait_partially_digested_desc: This leader has had an unfortunate encounter with a giant worm from another dimension. While no longer whole of body, they have gained some unique insight into molecular Biology.
text.leader_trait_obelisk_curse_desc: A servant of the black obelisk, this leader claims to seek to restore the balance we have disrupted.
text.leader_trait_obelisk_curse_tt: As long as this leader is a councilor, they will sacrifice one population to the black obelisk every year.
text.leader_trait_planar_theorist_desc: This leader specializes in the study of Astral Rifts and the behavior of dimensions outside of our own.
text.leader_trait_academic_astral_rift_expert: The Rift beckons. The scholar answers the call.
text.leader_trait_foreign_consciousness_desc: This leader provides a vessel for a psionic, rift-born entity, allowing for greater understanding of the strange physics within the astral planes.
text.leader_trait_black_light_blinded_desc: Blinded by a dark sun in the astral planes, this leader has gained an insatiable hunger for knowledge.
text.leader_trait_sanitary_drone_desc: This leader learned how to clean well.
text.leader_trait_spacebender_desc: Deeply attuned to the spaces between space, this leader is capable of slipping easily across galaxies.
text.leader_trait_energy_weapon_specialist_de: The calculations and precise focusing it takes to properly calibrate energy weapons can be incredibly time consuming, but such skills come naturally to this commander.
text.leader_trait_blorg_insight_desc: Centuries of studying the broadcasts and culture of a certain species of upright mammal has made this individual brazenly eager to please. Some would say, annoyingly so.
text.mod_trait_storm_rider: §YTrait effects are increased while this Leader resides inside a cosmic storm.§!
text.leader_trait_limited_cyborg_desc: This leader has the least amount of implants necessary to function in a cybernetic society.
text.leader_trait_robotic_surrogate_desc: Cumbersome and slow, this robot body is a surrogate for a digitized leader in the $building_identity_repository$.
text.leader_trait_buccaneer_desc: A master of battlefield salvage, this leader is able to extract every ounce of value from even the most damaged wrecks.
text.leader_trait_trailblazer_desc: Enthralled by the rewarding prospects of the galactic frontier, this leader hopes to chart the furthest reaches of space.
text.leader_trait_treasure_hoarder_desc: No bounty is high enough to satisfy this leader's ambition. The accumulation of valuable resources is their primary motivation.
text.leader_trait_pirate_queen_desc: Years of skulduggery and outlandish exploits have created a leader who never leaves with less than she came for.
text.leader_trait_trophy_hunter_desc: Tempered by hardship and armed with a lifetime of experience, this commander has an uncanny understanding of Space Fauna. The key to a successful hunt is to think like one's prey, but of course, only the perfect shot will produce a perfect trophy.
text.leader_trait_gifted_trapper_desc: A skilled researcher who takes the utmost care in the safe capture and transportation of live specimens. This leader's commitment to creature welfare inspires others to improve research standards across all disciplines.
text.leader_trait_void_hunter_desc: A knowledgeable hunter, well-suited for taking down big game. Patient in their approach, and precise when they strike.
text.leader_trait_void_tracker_desc: This leader's talent for capturing wild Space Fauna efficiently and safely is unparalleled.
text.leader_trait_cutholoid_victim_desc: This leader was trapped for some time in the digestive system of a spaceborne Cutholoid. While no longer whole of body, they have gained some unique insight into molecular Biology.
text.trait_leader_second_chanced_desc: This leader was saved from certain death by their unique biology, it will not happen again.
text.trait_ruler_apex_predator_desc: A people defined by Evolutionary Predation would allow none but their most adaptable to lead them. This apex ruler not only harvests the genomes of defeated foes, but also appropriates their cunning and resolve, turning every victory into a step toward perfect mastery.
text.trait_leader_genetic_purist_desc: This leader's work is guided by an unshakable vision of genetic perfection, and an intolerance for imperfection in all its forms.
text.leader_trait_altered_metabolism_desc: Fieldwork exposure to foreign agents has left a lasting impact on this leader.
text.leader_trait_hardened_survivalist_desc: This leader has unparalleled knowledge of inhospitable environments.
text.leader_trait_judicial_subjugation_desc: There will be productive lawful order, or there will be consequences.
text.leader_trait_judicial_execution_desc: There can be no repeat offenders when the sentence is death.

text.leader_trait_unplugged_cybernetic_positi: This leader has delegated several core body functions to hardware which prioritizes combat awareness.
This leader is able to integrate seamlessly and directly with military and civilian systems, at significant cost to their organic senses.
Significant augmentation of this leader's senses and immune systems ensures longevity, reliability, and only minor loss of reproductive function.
text.leader_trait_hibernating_desc: This leader hibernates for extended periods, lowering maintenance costs but also reducing active duty time
text.leader_trait_whispering_mind_desc: This leader's mind is flooded with whispers, each with unique intent. They commune with not one entity, but thousands.
text.leader_trait_shroud_warped_desc: Absorbed and reconstructed by the Shroud, the ethereal wisdom bestowed upon this leader grants them the power to observe the unobservable, and amplify the psionic potential of those around them.
text.leader_trait_shroud_warped_invasion_effe: Intel on enemy empire per invasion win: §G+$@shroud_warped_intel|0$§!
text.leader_trait_shroudshaper_desc: This leader is an everlasting being that wields incredible psionic power, helping shape the Shroud to our own will.
text.leader_trait_iron_will_desc: A masterful commander of the $MINDWARDEN_plural$, renowned for expertise in heavy fortifications and psychic resistance.
text.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_cradle_desc: The more we see the more we know, $the_cradle_of_souls_article$ grows more secure as we observe our neighbors.
text.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_cradle_envo: $t$- Envoys assigned to Patrons generate §G+0.5§! £zro£ §Y$sr_zro$§! per month
text.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_eater_desc: This leader has taken a blood vow with $the_eater_of_worlds_article$.
text.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_eater_attun: §G+$@disciple_of_the_eater_combat_attunement$§! Attunement to $the_eater_of_worlds_article$ per Fleet Combat won
text.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_eater_zro_a: $t$- §G+$@disciple_of_the_eater_zro_army_attack|0$§! $i_zro$ per 1% of devastation inflicted by assault armies
text.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_instrument_: Deeply attuned to $the_instrument_of_desire_article$, this leader can divine the presence of resources even in the most inhospitable corners of the galaxy.
text.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_composer_de: The more flesh they shape, the more their own unravels. $the_composer_of_strands_article_cap$ remakes all who dare to learn its forbidden art.
text.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_whisperers_: This leader hears $whisperers_in_the_void_article$ echoing through the Shroud, granting rare scientific insight into the hidden mechanisms of the physical universe.
text.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_end_desc: A devoted apostle of $end_of_the_cycle_article$, their unshakable faith in the coming of the $NAME_Reckoning$ echoes through every battle they wage.
text.leader_trait_disciple_of_the_end_effects: $t$- $@disciple_of_the_end_aura_intensity|0=+$ Aura Intensity per ship destroyed in the system$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $@disciple_of_the_end_jumpdrive_range|0=+%$ $MOD_SHIP_FTL_JUMPDRIVE_RANGE_MULT$ while in the §H$end_aura$§!
text.leader_trait_blinded_desc: There are such sights yet to be seen.
text.leader_trait_paladin_desc: This leader bears the mantle of the Paladin. Through word and deed, they embody valor itself, champions of a free galaxy.
text.leader_trait_paladin_effect: This leader has no §YUpkeep§! and does not take up §YLeader Capacity§!
text.leader_trait_paladin_ace_desc: With snap decisions and reflexes, this Paladin is expert at threading the needle to strike at the heart of our enemies.
text.leader_trait_paladin_strategist_desc: Calm and collected, this calculating Paladin is expert at formulating plans that will bring out the best in their companions.
text.leader_trait_paladin_strategist_tt: Fleets in system:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Ship Fire Rate: §G+30%§!
text.leader_trait_paladin_ambusher_desc: Patient and precise, this focused Paladin is expert at delivering the decisive strike.
text.leader_trait_paladin_logistician_desc: The quick mind and scientific training of this Paladin lets them solve logistic and maintenance questions, even in the heat of battle.
text.leader_trait_paladin_defender_desc: This stalwart and unflinching Paladin trusts in the ship and the crew to stand firm against overwhelming odds, and is always ready to shield any ally in need.
text.leader_trait_paladin_spearhead_desc: This brave Paladin does not shy away from fighting in the front line, coordinating allies to strike down even the most fearsome foe.
text.leader_trait_paladin_knight_desc: This Paladin has taken the oath of valor. Their peerless skill in battle is matched only by their unshakeable resolve.
text.leader_trait_nomadic_revenant_desc: This leader carries the scars of a purged world. Swearing eternal vengeance, their presence drives allies to strike harder at those who would commit such atrocities.
text.leader_trait_nomadic_sage_desc: $NAME_nomadic_sage$ carries no burden of command, yet all who walk beside her find their own steps steadier. True wisdom clears a path for those who lead.
text.leader_trait_nomadic_naturalist_desc: To find life is to be changed by it. Each new species, each strange ecology teaches us how to live a little better.
text.leader_trait_nomadic_caregiver_desc: With each completed Contract, this leader turns the Arkship into a cradle of growth and learning.
text.leader_trait_nomadic_caregiver_effect:
$t$- $mod_planet_researchers_produces_mult$: §G+3%§!
$t$- Effects increase by §G+3%§! for each completed §HContract§! (up to §G+15%§!)
$t$- $mod_planet_researchers_amenities_produces_add$: §G+150§!
text.leader_trait_nomadic_champion_desc: Each battle leaves its mark, and $NAME_nomadic_champion$ collects them all. His laughter turns danger into triumph, and his trophies remind the fleet what we're fighting for.
text.leader_trait_amnesiac_desc: $NAME_nomadic_princess$ has forgotten her past, yet her memories may be recovered by returning her to what was lost.
text.leader_trait_nomadic_princess_1_desc: Within the recovered Arkship, memories settle into place. §H$NAME_nomadic_princess$§! has regained fragments of the training once meant to guide her people. Her calm presence and steady insight make her a natural mediator among star-faring powers.
text.leader_trait_nomadic_princess_2_desc: §H$NAME_nomadic_princess$§!'s return to the recovered Arkship has awakened the full breadth of her training. She now steps into the role she was meant to fill.
text.leader_trait_circuit_champion_desc: A winner of a grand race across the stars, this leader stands tall and inspires others.
text.leader_trait_sable_pilot_desc: A Mysterious pilot, and a master of speed, this leader now coordinates fleets through complex maneuvers.
text.leader_trait_plunderer_desc: There is no need for the wreckage of enemy ships go to waste. A resourceful admiral knows exactly how to turn scrap into value.
text.subclass_commander_admiral_desc: The stoic presence of a decisive Admiral steels the nerves of the crew as they engage the enemy.
text.subclass_commander_general_desc: The presence of a General allows for improved coordination of planetary invasions.
text.subclass_commander_governor_desc: Commissioners specialize in imposing order through force, governing planets and sectors with military rigor and a strong vision.
text.subclass_commander_councilor_desc: Strategists are focused on the bigger picture. Instead of leading the battle up front, they prefer to maintain cohesion in the military and draw galaxy-spanning war plans.
text.subclass_official_delegate_desc: As the public face of our empire, Delegates represent our interests in Federations and in the Galactic Community.
text.delegate_subclass_tt: §GVeteran Class focused on our representation in Federations and the [GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]§!
text.subclass_official_governor_desc: Knowledge and skills in maintaining production quotas or material procurement come naturally to this leader.
text.subclass_official_diplomacy_councilor_de: Ambassadors maintain our relationships with other empires, both overtly and in more subtle ways. The art of diplomacy and the subtle craft of espionage both fall under their domain.
text.subclass_official_economy_councilor_desc: The budget of our empire is in the hand of our Advisors, a class of leaders who specialize in economic theory.
text.subclass_scientist_explorer_desc: To explore unknown worlds, catalog new species, and encounter new civilizations: this leader is the embodiment of such ideals.
text.explorer_subclass_tt: §GVeteran Class focused on exploration and surveying§!
text.subclass_scientist_scholar_desc: The galaxy is full of mysteries, and Scholars exist to solve them. These adventurous researchers excel in the study of dig sites, spacial anomalies and other mysteries.
text.scholar_subclass_tt: §GVeteran Class focused on investigating anomalies and dig sites§!
text.subclass_scientist_governor_desc: Being at the forefront of science, conducting experiments, and researching new technologies to better the empire is the main concern of any determined Analyst.
text.subclass_scientist_councilor_desc: Statisticians are the driving force behind the management of research teams and projects. Focusing on new technologies, these individuals pursue knowledge relentlessly.
text.leader_trait_sentinel_desc: Sentinel fleet commanders possess detailed knowledge of Prethoryn anatomy and tactics.
text.leader_trait_hive_affinity_desc: The Prethoryn creatures operating under this fleet consciousness have managed to attain an unusual level of affinity to one another. Their firing discipline has greatly improved, leading to a higher rate of fire.
text.leader_trait_void_swimmer_desc: The hunting instincts of this fleet consciousness has driven the Prethoryn creatures under its dominion into a frenzy. Their eagerness for battle drives them ever forward.
text.leader_trait_ethereal_desc: Some extradimensional fleet lords have learned to use the ethereal nature of their vessels to greatly enhance their evasive capabilities in combat.
text.leader_trait_dimensional_stutter_desc: For unknown reasons, the vessels under the command of this extradimensional fleet lord seem to rapidly stutter in and out of existence as they move, which has the effect of increasing their sublight speeds.
text.leader_trait_cybrex_desc: This Cybrex leader is equipped with ancient tactical databases from their civilization's violent past.
text.leader_trait_great_khan_desc: The Great Khan is a charismatic leader, a brilliant tactician, and, if the rumors are true, a powerful psychic.
text.EVERY_ENEMY_SHIP_DESTROYED_TXT: For Every Enemy Empire Ship Destroyed
text.PER_5_NAVAL_CAP_TXT: per §Y$@corvette_size_multiplier|0$§! §HNaval Capacity§! of the destroyed ship
text.EVERY_ARMY_KILLED_TXT: For Every Enemy Army Killed in Combat
text.adventurous_spirit_not_on_council: §EEffects apply while NOT on the Council.§!
text.imperial_heir_desc: The heir is next in line to rule the Empire.
text.leader_trait_academic_minor_artifacts_ex: Chance to discover $r_minor_artifacts$ Deposit upon excavating an Archaeology Site:
text.leader_trait_salvager_regular_desc: This academic is a salvaging savant who can disassemble even the most damaged ships and repurpose them as something useful.
text.leader_trait_chosen_default_desc: This leader is the $leader_trait_chosen$, an everlasting being that wields incredible psionic power.
text.leader_trait_scientist_brainslug_desc: This leader is enjoying the presence of a neural symbiont: a helpful slug that attaches itself to the brain stem of its host.
text.shroud_touched_intro: Passage through the Shroud is not lightly taken;
text.leader_trait_resolution_category_focus_f:
When you Support a Resolution that passes in this Category:
$tt$
Chance to gain 1 §YFavor§! with the Proposing Empire:
text.leader_trait_storm_rider_desc: Storm Riders revel in the rush of adrenaline, unlocking their true potential in the torrent of a cosmic storm. Council positions replace their field bonuses with council bonuses.
text.trait_cyborg_ritualistic_implants_desc: The faithful proudly adorn these implants. Their dedication to the divine is an inspiration to all.
text.leader_trait_has_backup_clone_default_de: This leader has a clone of [root.GetHimselfHerself] maintained in a storage facility, with regular memory transfers.
text.leader_trait_backup_clone_default_desc: This leader is a clone of a recently deceased leader, suffering from [GetDegradationLevel] degradation.
